required_freeze_contract: Use a unique plan_id for the exact empirical study, not for this template.
Pin the exact authorized source/corpus version and state the inclusion/exclusion rules before hypothesis outcomes are inspected.
Freeze primary hypotheses, null models, test statistics, effect-size and uncertainty thresholds, multiplicity correction, missing-data rules, and mandatory sensitivity analyses.
Record the frozen plan in an immutable, timestamped HTTPS registration record. A repository path or commit identifier alone is not asserted to be an external pre-registration record.
Bind the exact on-disk plan bytes with lowercase SHA-256 in the input manifest; changing one byte invalidates the plan digest and rights-review scope digest.
Keep the registered date and registration URL identical in the manifest and the plan file.
Do not analyze restricted source material unless the separate source authorization manifest is authorized for the declared purpose.

A plan marked registered must include concrete hypotheses with unique IDs, primary test, analysis unit and falsification rule; each null model must specify what it preserves, the randomization/permutation and the resampling unit.

Populate source/version pin, inclusion and exclusion criteria, primary outcomes, mandatory sensitivity analyses, effect/uncertainty/decision thresholds, multiplicity correction, missing-data policy, split strategy and deviation policy. Boolean frozen flags alone are insufficient.

The plan must enumerate exact authorized-source bindings (intake source ID, record URL, file URL, relative artifact path, SHA-256, byte count, and selected work/movement IDs); the validator must compare this list with the approved input manifest.
limitations: This checked-in file is a blocked template, not a registered plan.
The Choro source intake remains metadata-only; no score or corpus file is authorized.
Template values cannot support an empirical result or an authenticity claim.
